Trim whitespace from all character cells in a data frame

Source: R/FUNCTIONS_STRINGS.R
str_trim_df.Rd

Applies strwrap to every character cell in a data frame, removing leading and trailing whitespace.

Usage

str_trim_df(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing one or more character columns.

Value

A data frame of the same dimensions with whitespace trimmed from all character cells. Non-character cells are unchanged.

Examples

string <- data.frame(
  str1 = rep(paste0(sample(c(LETTERS, rep(" ", 10))), collapse = ""), 10),
  str2 = rep(paste0(sample(c(LETTERS, rep(" ", 10))), collapse = ""), 10),
  num1 = rnorm(10),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
str_trim_df(string)
